purpose: Admin asset metadata mutation payload for reviewed update requests and direct admin asset API updates.
ownedRules: Supports updating or clearing category family, subcategory, product SKU, tags, SEO title, and SEO description while preserving omitted fields.
Tags are normalized and validated through AssetTagRules during record construction.
Bean validation mirrors the tag contract with 40-character values, 16 tags maximum, and uppercase A-Z/0-9/hyphen/underscore tokens.
